policy.text: Remove the two stops on Ang Mo Kio Avenue 3 from bus service 265 and run non-stop between the interchange and the Avenue 10 stop. No extra buses, the fleet stays the same size.
policy.objective: reduce journey time and operating cost

reading.claim: You want to cut journey time and running cost.
reading.why: Read from 'run non-stop' and 'no extra buses'. Both become objectives it scores against.

reading.claim: Two stops come out of service 265.
reading.why: 'The two stops on Ang Mo Kio Avenue 3' matched exactly two stops on that road served by 265. Three matches would have stopped and asked.
'No extra buses' is a hard constraint, not a preference. Any alternative needing more vehicles is rejected before it is simulated.
You did not say when the express segment runs. It assumed all day. Change it if that is wrong.

interventions.name: Peak-hour stop retention
interventions.rationale: Keeps the stop open when the clinic and work trips actually happen.

interventions.name: Zone C shuttle feeder
interventions.rationale: Shortens the walk instead of restoring the stop.

interventions.name: Reroute service 262
interventions.rationale: Uses an existing feeder rather than adding vehicles.

interventions.name: Subsidised transport for flagged residents
interventions.rationale: Bypasses the network for the people who lost access.

interventions.name: Phased rollout over two quarters
interventions.rationale: Delays the change so residents can adjust.
validation_errors: defers harm without reducing it; final-state harm is unchanged

responses.comment: The covered walkway stops at Blk 226. Past that you are in the sun or the rain the whole way, and there is a slope. My mother will not do it.
Faster to the interchange in the morning, which I do notice. But my neighbour who uses a walking frame simply cannot get to the new stop.
Nobody asked the people who take the 265 to the polyclinic on a Tuesday.
Saves me about five minutes each way. I support it.
I will end up driving my father, which means I am late for work twice a week.

discovered_constraint.note: The model treats every 500 m of walk as equivalent. This one is not.
